text:
{
  "schema_version": "1.1",
  "characters": [
    { "id": "CHAR_ARTIE", "name": "Artie" },
    { "id": "CHAR_SYSTEM", "name": "The System" },
    { "id": "CHAR_KING_SLIME", "name": "King Slime" },
    { "id": "CHAR_GUILD_LEADER", "name": "Guild Leader Vane" },
    { "id": "CHAR_BOUNTY_HUNTER", "name": "The Nullifier" },
    { "id": "CHAR_REGIONAL_BOSS", "name": "The Data-Wraith" }
  ],
  "threads": [
    { "id": "THREAD_STABILITY", "title": "Class Stability Meter" },
    { "id": "THREAD_LOOT_EXPLOIT", "title": "Economic Destabilization" },
    { "id": "THREAD_PURSUIT", "title": "The Sentinel Hunt" }
  ],
  "chapters": [
    {
      "chapter_id": 1,
      "title": "Critical Failure to Launch",
      "goal": "Artie is isekai'd into the world of Aethelgard and discovers his 'Glitch-Crit' class during a tutorial fight gone wrong.",
      "sections": [
        {
          "section_id": 1,
          "title": "Office Space to Outer Space",
          "end_condition": "Artie completes the character creation process and stands in the world of Aethelgard.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 1,
              "type": "setup",
              "outcome": "Artie's office environment begins to disintegrate into digital code.",
              "location_start_label": "Office Cubicle",
              "location_end_label": "Office Cubicle",
              "location_start": "A gray cubicle filled with spreadsheets and cold coffee.",
              "location_end": "A disintegrating office space with pixels falling from the ceiling.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "The hum of the fluorescent lights suddenly changed pitch to a digital whine.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["fluorescent lights", "spreadsheets", "cold coffee"],
              "transition_out_text": "The floor vanished, leaving Artie suspended in a void of glowing blue text.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["pixelated floor", "blue text", "void"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:2"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 2,
              "type": "development",
              "outcome": "Artie selects the 'Glitch-Crit' class after the system menu malfunctions.",
              "location_start_label": "The System Void",
              "location_end_label": "The System Void",
              "location_start": "An infinite black space filled with floating UI windows.",
              "location_end": "The center of the void where a corrupted class icon glows.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "processed",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:1",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie reached out to touch the flickering 'Warrior' icon, but the menu lagged.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["UI windows", "lagging menu", "flickering icon"],
              "transition_out_text": "A blinding flash of light signaled the completion of the character bind.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["blinding light", "character bind", "system chime"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:3"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 3,
              "type": "payoff",
              "outcome": "Artie materializes in the tutorial zone of Aethelgard.",
              "location_start_label": "The System Void",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Plains",
              "location_start": "The fading interface of the character creator.",
              "location_end": "A lush green field with a giant floating 'TUTORIAL' sign.",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:2",
              "transition_in_text": "The void collapsed inward, pulling Artie into a vortex of grass and sunlight.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["vortex", "grass", "sunlight"],
              "transition_out_text": "He stood firm on the grass, a wooden sword appearing in his hand.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["green grass", "wooden sword", "tutorial sign"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:4",
              "end_condition_echo": "Artie completes the character creation process and stands in the world of Aethelgard."
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 2,
          "title": "The Tutorial Bug",
          "end_condition": "The tutorial boss is defeated via an unintended mechanical exploit.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 4,
              "type": "setup",
              "outcome": "Artie engages a basic slime and realizes his damage numbers are fluctuating wildly.",
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Plains",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Plains",
              "location_start": "The starting point of the tutorial zone.",
              "location_end": "A small clearing where a blue slime bounces.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:3",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie took a tentative step toward the first monster he'd ever seen.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["blue slime", "wooden sword", "combat music"],
              "transition_out_text": "The slime lunged, and Artie swung his sword in a desperate arc.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["slime lunge", "sword swing", "damage pop-up"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:5"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 5,
              "type": "development",
              "outcome": "A critical hit triggers a 'Glitch-Crit' that deals 1,000x damage to a minor mob.",
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Plains",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Plains",
              "location_start": "The clearing with the blue slime.",
              "location_end": "A scorched patch of earth where the slime once stood.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:4",
              "transition_in_text": "The moment the sword connected, the world froze for a microsecond.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["frozen time", "digital spark", "critical hit"],
              "transition_out_text": "The slime didn't just die; it was erased from the server.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["erased mob", "scorched earth", "system warning"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:6"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 6,
              "type": "development",
              "outcome": "The King Slime spawns as a scripted response to the 'overkill' event.",
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Plains",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Plains",
              "location_start": "The scorched clearing.",
              "location_end": "The clearing, now dominated by a massive, crown-wearing slime.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:5",
              "transition_in_text": "A massive shadow loomed over Artie as the sky turned a deep, angry purple.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["massive shadow", "purple sky", "boss roar"],
              "transition_out_text": "The King Slime slammed down, shaking the very foundations of the zone.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["boss slam", "ground shake", "crown"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:7"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 7,
              "type": "payoff",
              "outcome": "Artie exploits a frame-perfect glitch to one-shot the tutorial boss.",
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Plains",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Plains",
              "location_start": "The clearing under the King Slime.",
              "location_end": "A massive crater where the boss was defeated.",
              "handoff_mode": "combat_disengage",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:6",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie noticed the boss's hitbox flickering at the edge of his vision.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["hitbox flicker", "frame-perfect", "glitch-crit"],
              "transition_out_text": "The King Slime exploded into a fountain of gold and broken code.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["gold fountain", "broken code", "victory screen"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:8",
              "end_condition_echo": "The tutorial boss is defeated via an unintended mechanical exploit."
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 3,
          "title": "Resource Management",
          "end_condition": "Artie identifies the specific rare resources required to stabilize his class.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 8,
              "type": "setup",
              "outcome": "Artie reviews his loot and finds the 'Stability Meter' warning for the first time.",
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Plains",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Plains",
              "location_start": "The crater left by the King Slime.",
              "location_end": "The edge of the crater where Artie sits to rest.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:7",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie wiped the slime residue from his face and opened his inventory.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["slime residue", "inventory screen", "stability meter"],
              "transition_out_text": "A red flashing icon indicated his class was 15% unstable.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["red flashing icon", "instability", "warning message"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:9"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 9,
              "type": "development",
              "outcome": "Artie interacts with a corrupted terminal that provides cryptic lore about his class.",
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Plains",
              "location_end_label": "Hidden Terminal",
              "location_start": "The edge of the crater.",
              "location_end": "A stone plinth with a flickering holographic screen.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:8",
              "transition_in_text": "Beneath the grass, a metallic surface hummed with the same frequency as his class.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["metallic surface", "humming", "holographic screen"],
              "transition_out_text": "The screen displayed a map of the Whispering Woods and a list of components.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["map", "whispering woods", "component list"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:10"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 10,
              "type": "payoff",
              "outcome": "Artie commits to finding 'Glitch-Shards' to prevent his character from being deleted.",
              "location_start_label": "Hidden Terminal",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Exit",
              "location_start": "The flickering terminal.",
              "location_end": "The gate leading out of the tutorial zone.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:9",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie memorized the coordinates before the terminal short-circuited.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["coordinates", "short-circuit", "tutorial gate"],
              "transition_out_text": "He stepped through the gate, leaving the safety of the tutorial behind.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["tutorial gate", "safety", "open world"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:1",
              "end_condition_echo": "Artie identifies the specific rare resources required to stabilize his class."
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "chapter_id": 2,
      "title": "The Math of Murder-Hoboing",
      "goal": "Artie attempts to grind low-level mobs but accidentally triggers a recursive loot exploit that robs a local dungeon dry.",
      "sections": [
        {
          "section_id": 1,
          "title": "The Grind is Real",
          "end_condition": "Artie triggers a recursive loot loop in the Whispering Woods.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 1,
              "type": "setup",
              "outcome": "Artie enters the Whispering Woods and begins hunting Blink Rabbits.",
              "location_start_label": "Whispering Woods Entrance",
              "location_end_label": "Blink Rabbit Burrow",
              "location_start": "The dark, rustling edge of the forest.",
              "location_end": "A clearing filled with teleporting rabbits.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:10",
              "transition_in_text": "The air in the woods smelled of pine and ozone.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["pine smell", "ozone", "blink rabbits"],
              "transition_out_text": "He spotted his first target, a rabbit that flickered in and out of existence.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["target", "flickering rabbit", "wooden sword"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:2"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 2,
              "type": "development",
              "outcome": "Artie discovers that his Glitch-Crit causes mobs to drop loot multiple times.",
              "location_start_label": "Blink Rabbit Burrow",
              "location_end_label": "Blink Rabbit Burrow",
              "location_start": "The rabbit clearing.",
              "location_end": "A pile of rabbit fur and copper coins.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:1",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie's sword caught the rabbit mid-teleport, triggering a stutter in the game logic.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["mid-teleport", "stutter", "game logic"],
              "transition_out_text": "Instead of one pile of loot, four identical stacks appeared on the ground.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["loot pile", "identical stacks", "copper coins"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:3"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 3,
              "type": "payoff",
              "outcome": "Artie realizes he can chain these kills to create an infinite loot fountain.",
              "location_start_label": "Blink Rabbit Burrow",
              "location_end_label": "The Loot Vortex",
              "location_start": "The clearing with four loot piles.",
              "location_end": "A clearing where loot is spawning faster than it can be picked up.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:2",
              "transition_in_text": "He struck another rabbit, and the drop rate doubled again.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["drop rate", "loot fountain", "recursive loop"],
              "transition_out_text": "The ground was soon buried in a sea of copper and fur.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["buried ground", "sea of copper", "rabbit fur"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:4",
              "end_condition_echo": "Artie triggers a recursive loot loop in the Whispering Woods."
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 2,
          "title": "Looting the World Dry",
          "end_condition": "The Whispering Woods dungeon is rendered completely empty of items and monsters.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 4,
              "type": "setup",
              "outcome": "The loot loop begins to consume the local server resources, causing the environment to lag.",
              "location_start_label": "The Loot Vortex",
              "location_end_label": "The Loot Vortex",
              "location_start": "The clearing buried in loot.",
              "location_end": "A clearing where the trees are losing their textures.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:3",
              "transition_in_text": "The sheer volume of items began to strain the reality of the woods.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["server strain", "lag", "texture loss"],
              "transition_out_text": "Artie waded through the copper, his movements jerky and slow.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["copper wading", "jerky movements", "slow motion"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:5"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 5,
              "type": "development",
              "outcome": "Artie moves through the dungeon, the exploit 'vacuuming' all entities into his inventory.",
              "location_start_label": "The Loot Vortex",
              "location_end_label": "The Hollow Dungeon",
              "location_start": "The clearing.",
              "location_end": "The interior of a dungeon where even the torches have been looted.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:4",
              "transition_in_text": "Every step he took caused nearby objects to pop into his bags.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["inventory vacuum", "popping objects", "looted torches"],
              "transition_out_text": "He reached the boss room, but there was nothing left to fight.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["boss room", "empty space", "silence"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:6"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 6,
              "type": "payoff",
              "outcome": "Artie stands in a completely 'de-rezzed' dungeon, having extracted every possible value.",
              "location_start_label": "The Hollow Dungeon",
              "location_end_label": "The Hollow Dungeon",
              "location_start": "The empty boss room.",
              "location_end": "A gray, featureless box where the dungeon used to be.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:5",
              "transition_in_text": "The last monster flickered and vanished without Artie even swinging his sword.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["vanishing monster", "de-rezzed", "gray box"],
              "transition_out_text": "He was the only thing left in a world of gray geometry.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["gray geometry", "extracted value", "hollow world"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:7",
              "end_condition_echo": "The Whispering Woods dungeon is rendered completely empty of items and monsters."
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 3,
          "title": "Market Crash",
          "end_condition": "Artie observes the Adventurers' Guild arriving to investigate the 'looted' dungeon.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 7,
              "type": "setup",
              "outcome": "Artie dumps his massive haul onto the local market, causing prices to plummet.",
              "location_start_label": "The Hollow Dungeon",
              "location_end_label": "Market Square",
              "location_start": "The gray box of the dungeon.",
              "location_end": "A bustling town square with confused merchants.",
              "handoff_mode": "time_skip",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:6",
              "transition_in_text": "An hour later, Artie stood before the head merchant with a mountain of copper.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["head merchant", "mountain of copper", "market square"],
              "transition_out_text": "The price of copper crashed from ten silver to one tin in seconds.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["price crash", "silver to tin", "economic chaos"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:8"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 8,
              "type": "payoff",
              "outcome": "Artie hides as a high-level Guild investigation team arrives at the forest.",
              "location_start_label": "Market Square",
              "location_end_label": "Town Shadows",
              "location_start": "The market square.",
              "location_end": "An alleyway overlooking the town gate.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "pursued",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:7",
              "transition_in_text": "The sound of heavy plate armor echoed as the Guild investigators rode into town.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["plate armor", "investigators", "town gate"],
              "transition_out_text": "Artie pulled his hood low, watching them head toward the woods he'd just destroyed.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["hood", "watching", "investigation team"],
              "hands_off_to": "3:1",
              "end_condition_echo": "Artie observes the Adventurers' Guild arriving to investigate the 'looted' dungeon."
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "chapter_id": 3,
      "title": "Grand Theft Artifact",
      "goal": "Artie is forced to steal a legendary 'Cooldown Reset' gem to keep his unstable class from self-destructing.",
      "sections": [
        {
          "section_id": 1,
          "title": "The Stability Tax",
          "end_condition": "Artie locates the 'Cooldown Reset' gem within the city's high-security vault.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 1,
              "type": "setup",
              "outcome": "Artie's stability meter hits 40%, causing his UI to glitch and distort.",
              "location_start_label": "Town Shadows",
              "location_end_label": "Town Shadows",
              "location_start": "A dark alleyway.",
              "location_end": "The same alleyway, now seen through a distorted, static-filled lens.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:8",
              "transition_in_text": "A sharp pain lanced through Artie's head as a system alert blared.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["sharp pain", "system alert", "distorted lens"],
              "transition_out_text": "The world began to look like a corrupted video file.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["corrupted file", "static", "instability"],
              "hands_off_to": "3:2"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 2,
              "type": "development",
              "outcome": "Artie uses a 'Search' glitch to find the nearest high-tier energy source.",
              "location_start_label": "Town Shadows",
              "location_end_label": "City Streets",
              "location_start": "The alleyway.",
              "location_end": "A street corner near the massive stone vault of the capital.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "3:1",
              "transition_in_text": "He forced his glitch-class to 'ping' the environment for a fix.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["ping", "environment", "energy source"],
              "transition_out_text": "A glowing golden trail led straight to the city's central vault.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["golden trail", "central vault", "capital"],
              "hands_off_to": "3:3"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 3,
              "type": "payoff",
              "outcome": "Artie identifies the 'Chrono-Core' gem as his target.",
              "location_start_label": "City Streets",
              "location_end_label": "Vault Exterior",
              "location_start": "The street corner.",
              "location_end": "The heavily guarded entrance to the Royal Treasury.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "restricted",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "3:2",
              "transition_in_text": "He squinted through the static, seeing the gem's icon through the vault walls.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["chrono-core", "vault walls", "royal treasury"],
              "transition_out_text": "It was the only thing that could reset his crashing system.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["target identified", "crashing system", "gem icon"],
              "hands_off_to": "3:4",
              "end_condition_echo": "Artie locates the 'Cooldown Reset' gem within the city's high-security vault."
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 2,
          "title": "The Vault Heist",
          "end_condition": "Artie successfully acquires the Cooldown Reset gem.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 4,
              "type": "setup",
              "outcome": "Artie bypasses the outer guards by 'clipping' through a low-resolution wall.",
              "location_start_label": "Vault Exterior",
              "location_end_label": "Outer Vault Hall",
              "location_start": "The guarded gate.",
              "location_end": "A dimly lit corridor inside the vault.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "pursued",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "3:3",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie leaned against a corner of the building where the textures looked thin.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["thin textures", "wall clipping", "outer guards"],
              "transition_out_text": "With a sickening pop, he was on the other side of the stone.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["sickening pop", "other side", "stone wall"],
              "hands_off_to": "3:5"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 5,
              "type": "development",
              "outcome": "Artie uses a 'No-Clip' exploit to avoid a series of magical traps.",
              "location_start_label": "Outer Vault Hall",
              "location_end_label": "Inner Sanctum Path",
              "location_start": "The corridor.",
              "location_end": "A hallway filled with glowing red laser-like runes.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "restricted",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "3:4",
              "transition_in_text": "The floor was a patchwork of fire and lightning traps.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["fire traps", "lightning", "no-clip"],
              "transition_out_text": "He walked through the air, ignoring the laws of physics and magic.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["walking on air", "physics", "magic traps"],
              "hands_off_to": "3:6"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 6,
              "type": "development",
              "outcome": "Artie tricks a high-level Golem guardian into attacking its own reflection.",
              "location_start_label": "Inner Sanctum Path",
              "location_end_label": "The Gem Chamber",
              "location_start": "The trapped hallway.",
              "location_end": "A circular room with a massive stone guardian.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "3:5",
              "transition_in_text": "The Golem roared, its stone fists smashing the floor.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["golem roar", "stone fists", "reflection glitch"],
              "transition_out_text": "Artie spawned a mirror-image that didn't just distract; it counter-attacked.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["mirror-image", "counter-attack", "golem"],
              "hands_off_to": "3:7"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 7,
              "type": "payoff",
              "outcome": "Artie grabs the Chrono-Core, causing the vault's alarms to trigger.",
              "location_start_label": "The Gem Chamber",
              "location_end_label": "The Gem Chamber",
              "location_start": "The center of the chamber.",
              "location_end": "The chamber, now bathed in red emergency light.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "pursued",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "3:6",

              "transition_out_text": "He had the patch, but he had no place to hide.",

      "chapter_id": 7,
      "title": "Outrunning the Patch Notes",
      "goal": "Artie secures his loot and escapes into the next region just as the System initiates a 'Zone Reset'.",
      "sections": [
        {
          "section_id": 1,
          "title": "Patching the Hole",
          "end_condition": "The 'Stability Patch' is successfully integrated into Artie's character sheet.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 1,
              "type": "setup",
              "outcome": "Artie finds a quiet cave to apply the Stability Patch.",
              "location_start_label": "The Inner Sanctum",
              "location_end_label": "Hidden Cave",
              "location_start": "The fortress exit.",
              "location_end": "A dark, secluded cave on the mountain slope.",
              "handoff_mode": "time_skip",
              "constraint_state": "pursued",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "6:12",
              "transition_in_text": "He scrambled down the rocks, his heart hammering against his ribs.",

              "transition_out_text": "He finally found a crevice narrow enough to hide his presence.",

              "scene_id": 2,

              "location_end_label": "Hidden Cave",
              "location_start": "The back of the cave.",

              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",

              "consumes_outcome_from": "7:1",
              "transition_in_text": "He activated the golden disk, and a progress bar appeared in his vision.",

              "outcome": "The patch completes, locking Artie's class and removing the deletion threat.",
              "location_start_label": "Hidden Cave",
              "location_end_label": "Hidden Cave",
              "location_start": "The glowing cave.",
              "location_end": "The cave, now dark and silent again.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "7:2",

          "title": "The Deletion Event",

          "scenes": [

              "scene_id": 4,
              "type": "setup",
              "outcome": "The System initiates a 'Zone Reset' to purge the mountains of the anomaly.",
              "location_start_label": "Hidden Cave",
              "location_end_label": "Mountain Slope",
              "location_start": "The cave interior.",
              "location_end": "The mountainside, where trees are turning into white cubes.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "fleeing",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "7:3",
              "transition_in_text": "The ground began to vibrate with a low-frequency rumble.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["vibration", "zone reset", "white cubes"],
              "transition_out_text": "A wall of white nothingness began to sweep across the horizon.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["white nothingness", "horizon", "sweep"],
              "hands_off_to": "7:5"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 5,
              "type": "development",
              "outcome": "Artie uses his new stable glitches to outrun the deletion wall.",

              "location_end_label": "The Border Path",
              "location_start": "The mountainside.",
              "location_end": "A narrow bridge leading to the next region.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "fleeing",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "7:4",
              "transition_in_text": "He didn't just run; he manipulated the distance between his steps.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["manipulation", "distance", "deletion wall"],
              "transition_out_text": "The white wall was inches from his heels.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["inches", "heels", "border bridge"],

            {
              "scene_id": 6,
              "type": "payoff",
              "outcome": "Artie leaps across the region border just as the mountains vanish.",

              "consumes_outcome_from": "7:5",
              "transition_in_text": "He threw himself forward, crossing the invisible line between servers.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["leap", "invisible line", "server cross"],
              "transition_out_text": "Behind him, the mountains were gone, replaced by a 'ZONE UNDER MAINTENANCE' sign.",

              "hands_off_to": "7:7",
              "end_condition_echo": "Artie narrowly escapes the collapsing zone."

              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "7:6",
              "transition_in_text": "The air here was warm and smelled of honey.",

  ],
  "chapters": [
    {
      "chapter_id": 1,
      "title": "Critical Failure to Launch",
      "goal": "Artie is isekai'd into the world of Aethelgard and discovers his 'Glitch-Crit' class during a tutorial fight gone wrong.",
      "sections": [
        {
          "section_id": 1,
          "title": "Office Space to Outer Space",
          "end_condition": "Artie completes the character creation process and stands in the world of Aethelgard.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 1,
              "type": "setup",
              "outcome": "Artie's office environment begins to disintegrate into digital code.",
              "location_start_label": "Office Cubicle",
              "location_end_label": "Office Cubicle",
              "location_start": "A gray cubicle filled with spreadsheets and cold coffee.",
              "location_end": "A disintegrating office space with pixels falling from the ceiling.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "The hum of the fluorescent lights suddenly changed pitch to a digital whine.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["fluorescent lights", "spreadsheets", "cold coffee"],
              "transition_out_text": "The floor vanished, leaving Artie suspended in a void of glowing blue text.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["pixelated floor", "blue text", "void"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:2"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 2,
              "type": "development",
              "outcome": "Artie selects the 'Glitch-Crit' class after the system menu malfunctions.",
              "location_start_label": "The System Void",
              "location_end_label": "The System Void",
              "location_start": "An infinite black space filled with floating UI windows.",
              "location_end": "The center of the void where a corrupted class icon glows.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "processed",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:1",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie reached out to touch the flickering 'Warrior' icon, but the menu lagged.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["UI windows", "lagging menu", "flickering icon"],
              "transition_out_text": "A blinding flash of light signaled the completion of the character bind.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["blinding light", "character bind", "system chime"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:3"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 3,
              "type": "payoff",
              "outcome": "Artie materializes in the tutorial zone of Aethelgard.",
              "location_start_label": "The System Void",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Plains",
              "location_start": "The fading interface of the character creator.",
              "location_end": "A lush green field with a giant floating 'TUTORIAL' sign.",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:2",
              "transition_in_text": "The void collapsed inward, pulling Artie into a vortex of grass and sunlight.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["vortex", "grass", "sunlight"],
              "transition_out_text": "He stood firm on the grass, a wooden sword appearing in his hand.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["green grass", "wooden sword", "tutorial sign"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:4",
              "end_condition_echo": "Artie completes the character creation process and stands in the world of Aethelgard."
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 2,
          "title": "The Tutorial Bug",
          "end_condition": "The tutorial boss is defeated via an unintended mechanical exploit.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 4,
              "type": "setup",
              "outcome": "Artie engages a basic slime and realizes his damage numbers are fluctuating wildly.",
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Plains",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Plains",
              "location_start": "The starting point of the tutorial zone.",
              "location_end": "A small clearing where a blue slime bounces.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:3",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie took a tentative step toward the first monster he'd ever seen.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["blue slime", "wooden sword", "combat music"],
              "transition_out_text": "The slime lunged, and Artie swung his sword in a desperate arc.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["slime lunge", "sword swing", "damage pop-up"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:5"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 5,
              "type": "development",
              "outcome": "A critical hit triggers a 'Glitch-Crit' that deals 1,000x damage to a minor mob.",
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Plains",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Plains",
              "location_start": "The clearing with the blue slime.",
              "location_end": "A scorched patch of earth where the slime once stood.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:4",
              "transition_in_text": "The moment the sword connected, the world froze for a microsecond.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["frozen time", "digital spark", "critical hit"],
              "transition_out_text": "The slime didn't just die; it was erased from the server.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["erased mob", "scorched earth", "system warning"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:6"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 6,
              "type": "development",
              "outcome": "The King Slime spawns as a scripted response to the 'overkill' event.",
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Plains",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Plains",
              "location_start": "The scorched clearing.",
              "location_end": "The clearing, now dominated by a massive, crown-wearing slime.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:5",
              "transition_in_text": "A massive shadow loomed over Artie as the sky turned a deep, angry purple.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["massive shadow", "purple sky", "boss roar"],
              "transition_out_text": "The King Slime slammed down, shaking the very foundations of the zone.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["boss slam", "ground shake", "crown"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:7"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 7,
              "type": "payoff",
              "outcome": "Artie exploits a frame-perfect glitch to one-shot the tutorial boss.",
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Plains",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Plains",
              "location_start": "The clearing under the King Slime.",
              "location_end": "A massive crater where the boss was defeated.",
              "handoff_mode": "combat_disengage",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:6",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie noticed the boss's hitbox flickering at the edge of his vision.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["hitbox flicker", "frame-perfect", "glitch-crit"],
              "transition_out_text": "The King Slime exploded into a fountain of gold and broken code.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["gold fountain", "broken code", "victory screen"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:8",
              "end_condition_echo": "The tutorial boss is defeated via an unintended mechanical exploit."
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 3,
          "title": "Resource Management",
          "end_condition": "Artie identifies the specific rare resources required to stabilize his class.",

              "scene_id": 8,
              "type": "setup",
              "outcome": "Artie reviews his loot and finds the 'Stability Meter' warning for the first time.",
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Plains",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Plains",
              "location_start": "The crater left by the King Slime.",
              "location_end": "The edge of the crater where Artie sits to rest.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
